title: Specify router-aware semantic statuses in shared Gherkin
description: Define the behavior contract for router-aware status configuration in shared Gherkin. Canonical semantic categories are todo, in_progress, in_review, blocked, and done. A status may set router: true to mark the canonical router status for its semantic category. Require unique router-marked statuses per category and exactly one of each category when the router is enabled. Unmarked todo statuses must not become dispatch candidates or router transition targets. Specify that router.workflow is rejected after migration. Cover missing or duplicate markers, unsupported categories, Discovery intake, Ready exclusion, lifecycle destinations, and configured transition validation. Acceptance: both Behave and Rust Cucumber can parse the scenarios, and the scenarios fail against the old exact-key workflow configuration for the expected reasons.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Spec draft on branch spec/state-native-router-statuses (8c494e1a). Ryan's decisions 2026-10-16:
1. Unmarked todo issues (Ready, Backlog, others) appear in router plan output as deferred with reason status_not_router_intake, not omitted.
2. Statuses named review / blocked derive semantic categories in_review / blocked by default when no explicit category is set.
3. The load-time transition check covers the default workflow only (todo->in_progress, in_progress->in_review, in_progress->blocked, in_review->in_progress, in_review->done); per-type workflows are not checked and blocked->in_progress is not required.
4. Existing router features keep open as their marked intake in test fixtures; the Discovery board is exercised by the new lifecycle feature.
The spec branch merges together with kbs-64d9b4 so CI coverage never drops.

comments.text: Stopped 2026-10-16. This ticket's removal language is wrong and must be rewritten or the ticket closed before any further work. The branches spec/state-native-router-statuses and feat/state-native-router-config and draft PR #406 implement the removal and must not merge.
